It was contested by 12 teams, and [[C.F. Os Belenenses]] won the championship by one point,<ref>{{Cite web |title=Portugal 1945-46 |url=https://www.rsssf.org/tablesp/porthist194546.html |access-date=2025-03-22 |website=www.rsssf.org}}</ref> the first time that the competition had been won by a team outside the [[Big Three (Portugal)|Portuguese "Big Three" ''(Os Três Grandes)'']] of [[S.L. Benfica|Benfica]], [[FC Porto|Porto]] and [[Sporting Clube de Portugal|Sporting]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Ofori |first=Morgan |date=2023-11-22 |title='For me it's like a movie': the fall, fightback and rise of Belenenses |url=https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2023/nov/22/belenenses-fall-fightback-rise-portugal-football |access-date=2025-03-22 |work=The Observer |language=en-GB |issn=0029-7712}}</ref>
